qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/results/{editor,runtime,polish,persist-before,persist-after,restart}.json (sha256 of the six result JSONs and run_golden.sh recomputed and equal to the index)
evidence: Pairwise read of all 55 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraints gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). No pair grades the same observable for credit twice, none subsumes another, and no pair demands incompatible products. INDEPENDENCE: every place where two criteria share a scenario carries an explicit carve-out in the criterion text. functional/judge.toml: cw_multi_caret_delete and cw_same_line_carets 'whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere, not here' (owned by cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic); cw_same_line_carets 'Undo behaviour is not judged here'; cw_basic_run_output 'Whether output of the first Run is still left in the preview is scored elsewhere' (cw_run_starts_fresh_document); cw_output_before_failure_kept 'What the app says about why the run ended is scored by other criteria'; cw_last_good_recovery 'Whether a later valid Run works is scored elsewhere' versus cw_time_limit_recovery and cw_stop_cancels_pending_work 'Whether the earlier picture returns to the preview is scored elsewhere'; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft 'Whether B shows a conflict message is scored elsewhere' (cw_stale_save_refused); cw_history_restore_adds_revision 'What happens when the same restore request is sent twice is scored elsewhere' (cw_restore_request_repeat_safe); cw_long_line_editing 'Running the draft is not part of this criterion'. polish/judge.toml: cw_controls_feedback_and_labels and cw_narrow_width_usable 'Whether Run produces the right output is scored elsewhere'; cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere'. visual/judge.toml: the three likert criteria separate themselves ('This is about how the code looks, not whether token categories are correct'; 'Judge this separately from editor typography and from pane arrangement'). The split of refusal versus dirty-draft preservation follows qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('refusing a stale save and preserving the dirty editor are different outcomes'), and functional/prompt.md adds 'Never carry a verdict across criteria ... a failure in one must not fail another whose own steps passed'. NONCONTRADICTION: checked the pairs most likely to collide and each is reconcilable in one product: Tab indents (cw_block_indent_undo) versus keyboard exit from the editor (cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus allows a non-Tab exit shown on screen); unwrapped 500-character line and horizontal caret following versus 'The page must not scroll sideways' at 390px (editor scrolls internally); run-level five-second limit on self-rescheduling timers (cw_time_limit_recovery) versus a fresh budget after a settled run (cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget), matching behaviour.md 'After it settles, a later user interaction in the preview starts a fresh five-second budget'; last-good preview restore versus console output kept (preview versus console surfaces); replayed restore must not add a revision while 'the app's ordinary Restore control ... is allowed to add a revision'; one-Undo slow multi-caret burst versus the 'Press Undo repeatedly until' wording in cw_undo_restores_caret and cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (tolerant of any grouping); focus returning to the code after a mouse click on Save/Format/Undo versus keyboard reachability of the same controls. MEASURED: the scripted golden on these bytes satisfies all gate, functional and polish criteria simultaneously (editor.json 21 true, runtime.json 15 true, persist/restart and polish results, no false entries; hashes match raw-evidence-index.json), which demonstrates one product can meet every binary criterion at once. NOT MEASURED: no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so whether the judge honours the 'scored elsewhere' carve-outs is unobserved; the hosted run is on an earlier candidate and is not relied on. NOTES (not defects): (1) The constraints gate cw_shared_saved_record (save, clear browser storage, reload, exact title/filename/source) is repeated as the first half of functional cw_save_reload_restart. The gate has weight 0.0 and all_pass aggregation in scoring.toml, so it adds no second credit; the repeat costs judge time only, and the functional criterion adds the mid-line marker, revision/history and restart legs. (2) Shared-precondition cascades exist and are sanctioned controls rather than duplicate grading, but they concentrate weight: an app with no multi-caret loses cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic 2.0 + cw_multi_caret_delete 1.5 + cw_same_line_carets 2.0; an app with no run time limit fails cw_time_limit_recovery, and also cannot complete cw_last_good_recovery, cw_output_before_failure_kept ('enters an endless loop') and the second leg of cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget; an app that accepts a stale Save fails cw_stale_save_refused and, by its control ('If B's Save was accepted ... this criterion fails'), cw_stale_save_keeps_draft; an app with no live library refresh fails cw_live_library_update and cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state ('fails as well because the situation could not be produced'). Each later criterion observes a different outcome and the control is required by REVIEW_POLICY ('A negative needs a successful control'; 'A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing'). (3) Undo/Redo is a leg in about a dozen functional criteria (join, grapheme delete, paste, indent, multi-caret, replace current/all, both formats, caret restore). Each grades the atomicity of a different operation, which the skill's whole-flow exception permits, but an editor with no Undo at all loses a large share of functional weight; this is a weighting observation for the reward-soundness rows, not a row-28 defect. (4) Case-sensitive matching is observed in both cw_find_forward_backward_wrap (near-match never visited) and cw_replace_all_atomic (near-match unchanged): different operations, minor overlap.
